articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially rolled out GPT-5 across its API and ChatGPT tiers, featuring significantly improved chain-of-thought reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a 1M-token context window. Benchmarks show substantial gains on PhD-level science QA and complex code generation tasks, though independent evaluations note diminishing returns on certain narrow reasoning benchmarks compared to the GPT-4o to GPT-5 leap expectations.

articles.title: Google DeepMind Unveils Gemini 2.5 Ultra with Real-Time Agentic Capabilities
articles.summary: DeepMind released Gemini 2.5 Ultra, emphasizing autonomous multi-step agentic workflows that can browse the web, write and execute code, and manage files with minimal human oversight. The model integrates tightly with Google Workspace and Android, positioning Google to compete directly with OpenAI's operator-style agents. Early enterprise pilots report significant productivity gains in data analysis and software engineering pipelines.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Demonstrates Fully Autonomous Warehouse Operations at BMW Facility
articles.summary: Figure's second-generation humanoid robot, Figure 02, completed a 72-hour fully autonomous warehouse shift at a BMW logistics center in South Carolina, handling palletizing, bin picking, and inter-station transport without human intervention. The demonstration marks one of the first commercially viable deployments of general-purpose humanoid robots, with BMW announcing plans to scale to 500 units across North American plants by 2027.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Begins Limited Commercial Leasing for Industrial Applications
articles.summary: Tesla started offering its Optimus Gen 3 humanoid robot under a commercial lease program priced at roughly $25,000 per year, targeting repetitive manufacturing and logistics tasks. The robot features improved dexterous manipulation with 22-DOF hands and on-device vision-language model inference for task adaptation. Industry analysts note the aggressive pricing could accelerate humanoid adoption but question long-term reliability data.

articles.title: Anthropic Publishes Breakthrough Research on Mechanistic Interpretability of Large Reasoning Models
articles.summary: Anthropic researchers published a landmark paper demonstrating scalable methods for tracing specific reasoning chains inside transformer models back to identifiable circuit-level structures, extending their earlier work on monosemantic features to models with over 100 billion parameters. The work provides concrete tools for detecting deceptive reasoning patterns and hallucination sources, potentially reshaping how safety evaluations are conducted across the industry.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Gate-All-Around Process Node
articles.summary: TSMC announced the start of volume production on its A14 (1.4nm-class) process using gate-all-around nanosheet transistors at its Kaohsiung fab, with Apple and NVIDIA confirmed as early customers. The node delivers an estimated 15% speed improvement and 30% power reduction over N2, critical for next-generation AI accelerators and mobile SoCs operating under tight thermal envelopes.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Error-Corrected Logical Qubits Running Useful Algorithms
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum jointly demonstrated 32 error-corrected logical qubits running a materials-science simulation that would be intractable for classical supercomputers, using Quantinuum's latest trapped-ion hardware combined with Microsoft's qubit virtualization layer. While not yet at commercial scale, the result crosses a key threshold where quantum computation outperforms classical methods on a scientifically relevant problem rather than a contrived benchmark.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Now Handles Unstructured Outdoor Terrain with Dynamic Replanning
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics released a major software update for its electric Atlas humanoid platform enabling robust locomotion over unstructured outdoor terrain including mud, loose gravel, and steep inclines, using a learned world model for real-time footstep replanning. The capability opens construction and disaster-response applications that were previously limited to tracked or wheeled platforms, with Hyundai announcing pilot deployments at active construction sites in South Korea.
